orc.name: Orc
orc.description: Hardy fighters who rely on strength and cunning. Orcs have no affinity for magic.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Starts with Swordplay. Strong weapon techniques and durable health. Races able to use magic can study it at 35% power and twice the mana cost.

mage.name: Mage
mage.description: Starts with Fireball. Best spell power, mana and recovery; warrior techniques have only 30% power. Only mages can learn enchanting.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: Starts with Backstab. Agile specialist with dodge and escape bonuses. Races able to use magic can study it at 50% power and 1.5 times the mana cost.

bash.name: Bash
bash.description: A heavy strike. Can be used between automatic attacks.

knockout.name: Knockout
knockout.description: Weaken a capturable enemy, then attempt to knock it unconscious. Chance is reduced by its capture resistance. Success ends combat without kill rewards.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: A fire attack; 25% chance to scorch for three pulses. No mana cost.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.description: A forceful lightning attack; 15% chance to slow the target.

charge.name: Charge
charge.description: Initiate a fight or strike your current opponent. No movement between rooms.

sharpening.name: Sharpening
sharpening.description: Out of combat, sharpen your right-hand weapon temporarily.

enchanting.name: Enchanting
enchanting.description: ENCHANT <item>: temporarily enchant a held weapon or worn/held armor. Every valid attempt slowly trains your enchanting level; higher skill improves success, bonus and duration. Costs gold; weapon failures can damage or destroy the weapon. See Crafting & balance in the owner editor.

mend.name: Mend
mend.description: Spend mana to restore your own health. Valid healing slowly improves this spell.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.description: A precise close-range strike. Can start combat.

quickstrike.name: Quick Strike
quickstrike.description: A fast follow-up strike during combat.

hamstring.name: Hamstring
hamstring.description: A successful strike slows the selected enemy for two pulses.

swordplay.name: Swordplay
swordplay.description: Your basic weapon fighting ability. Additional learned ranks improve automatic attacks. Use ATTACK or KILL.

kick.name: Kick
kick.description: A forceful kick that can briefly stun the chosen opponent.

power_strike.name: Power Strike
power_strike.description: An advanced weapon technique. Strength depends on your class and learned rank.

shattering_strike.name: Shattering Strike
shattering_strike.description: An advanced weapon technique. Strength depends on your class and learned rank.

executioner.name: Executioner Strike
executioner.description: An advanced weapon technique. Strength depends on your class and learned rank.

cutthroat.name: Cutthroat
cutthroat.description: An advanced weapon technique. Strength depends on your class and learned rank.

nerve_strike.name: Nerve Strike
nerve_strike.description: An advanced weapon technique. Strength depends on your class and learned rank.

assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.description: An advanced weapon technique. Strength depends on your class and learned rank.

frostbolt.name: Frostbolt
frostbolt.description: A focused spell against your chosen enemy. Power, mana efficiency and practice depend on class.

arcane_lance.name: Arcane Lance
arcane_lance.description: A focused spell against your chosen enemy. Power, mana efficiency and practice depend on class.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.description: A focused spell against your chosen enemy. Power, mana efficiency and practice depend on class.

kingsfall.name: Kingsfall
kingsfall.description: A blacksteel longsword with a perfectly balanced edge. An extraordinary feat of smithing, without magic. A legendary enemy drop; never sold in shops.

mountainbreaker.name: Mountainbreaker
mountainbreaker.description: An immense two-handed axe forged from layered meteor iron. Its brutal cutting edge is entirely physical. A legendary enemy drop; never sold in shops.

starwake.name: Starwake
starwake.description: A slender blade carrying a cold seam of starlight. Each individual blade grows stronger through magical mastery. A legendary enemy drop; never sold in shops.

crownguard_helm.name: Crownguard Helm
crownguard_helm.description: A beautifully fitted steel helm with a reinforced brow and overlapping cheek guards. Nonmagical. A legendary enemy drop; never sold in shops.

ironheart_cuirass.name: Ironheart Cuirass
ironheart_cuirass.description: Closely articulated plates of exceptional steel protect the chest without a wasted gap. Nonmagical. A legendary enemy drop; never sold in shops.

pathwarden_greaves.name: Pathwarden Greaves
pathwarden_greaves.description: Layered thigh and shin plates flex smoothly over tough fitted leggings. Nonmagical. A legendary enemy drop; never sold in shops.

sentinel_vambraces.name: Sentinel Vambraces
sentinel_vambraces.description: Perfectly joined forearm plates turn blades away from wrist and elbow. Nonmagical. A legendary enemy drop; never sold in shops.

last_bastion.name: Last Bastion
last_bastion.description: A broad shield whose layered metal face bears the marks of a hundred victories. Nonmagical. A legendary enemy drop; never sold in shops.

rusted_sword.name: Rusted sword
rusted_sword.description: An old blade with a serviceable edge.

leather_vest.name: Leather vest
leather_vest.description: Patched leather keeps the worst of a blow away.

potion.name: Healing potion
potion.description: Restores 35 HP. USE POTION, even during combat.

lantern.name: Lumen lantern
lantern.description: An enclosed crystal provides light while carried. No fuel required.

chain_vest.name: Chain vest
chain_vest.description: Close iron links protect the torso.

relic_blade.name: Elvish Blade
relic_blade.description: A curved, sleek blade that looks timeless.  It shows not a single sign of wear.  It constantly glows blue and hums lightly.

scrap.name: Ancient scrap
scrap.description: A small fragment of machinery. The shop buys these.

elven_sword.name: Elven Sword
elven_sword.description: A elegant ageless sword.  It is magically sharpened and glows a faint blue.  When you hold it, you hear a light humming.

rubber_boots.name: Rubber Boots
rubber_boots.description: Simple.  Dependable.  Nice Rubber Boots.  They smell slightly like new tires.

iron_cage.name: Iron cage
iron_cage.description: A portable barred cage. It holds up to five creatures of one type, even while carried. Use PUT <creature> IN CAGE <number>, LOOK CAGE <number>, or DROP CAGE <number>.

rusty_crypt_key.name: Old rusty key
rusty_crypt_key.description: A brittle iron key found behind the vampire. It fits the old crypt box and crumbles after one use.

dawnfang.name: Dawnfang
dawnfang.description: A pale steel sword hidden in the vampire’s crypt. Its sunburst guard feels warm against your palm.

storage_chest.name: Storage chest
storage_chest.description: A sturdy portable chest. Store items with PUT <item> IN CHEST <number>; retrieve them with GET <item> FROM CHEST <number>.

recall_scroll.name: Recall scroll
recall_scroll.description: USE RECALL SCROLL to return to Center Square outside combat. Reusable at levels 1-2, consumed on use at levels 3-29, and unusable from level 30. Combat and room blocks preserve the scroll by default.

buckler.name: Wooden buckler
buckler.description: A small left-hand shield. Adds 1 armor; cannot share a two-handed weapon.

apple.name: Prairie apple
apple.description: A crisp fruit. EAT PRAIRIE APPLE restores a little health outside combat.

raw_venison.name: Raw venison
raw_venison.description: Harvested deer meat. Cook at a fire.

raw_turkey.name: Raw turkey
raw_turkey.description: Harvested turkey meat. Cook at a fire.

beetle_meat.name: Beetle meat
beetle_meat.description: Edible beetle flesh. Cook at a fire.

toasted_beetle.name: Toasted beetle
toasted_beetle.description: A crunchy frontier snack restores 8 HP.

leather_cap.name: Leather Cap
leather_cap.description: Sturdy leather cap made for frontier travel.

leather_pants.name: Leather Pants
leather_pants.description: Sturdy leather pants made for frontier travel.

leather_bracers.name: Leather Bracers
leather_bracers.description: Sturdy leather bracers made for frontier travel.

greatsword.name: Iron Greatsword
greatsword.description: A heavy iron blade that requires both hands.

beetle.name: Copper beetle
beetle.description: A knee-high beetle noses through the grass. It ignores you.
beetle.captive_description: Copper beetle watches from behind the bars.

goblin.name: Relic goblin
goblin.description: A goblin in scavenged copper plates guards the tunnel.
defeat_messages: The goblin drops its weapon and falls silent.
goblin.captive_description: Relic goblin watches from behind the bars.
captive_actions: The goblin rattles the bars and complains about the food.

sentinel.name: Broken sentinel
sentinel.description: An ancient machine rises on brass legs. Its cracked core burns blue. Random sounds of hissing spurt out from worn pistons.
sentinel.captive_description: Broken sentinel watches from behind the bars.

vampire.name: Dark Vampire
vampire.description:
She stands motionless at the far end of the dungeon chamber, where the torchlight seems reluctant to reach.

At first, she could almost be mistaken for a prisoner. Her skin is unnaturally pale beneath the grime of the dungeon, and long black hair falls loosely over her shoulders. Her clothing was once elegant—a dark, fitted dress of fine fabric—but time and captivity have left it torn and stained.

Her eyes glow a deep, unnatural crimson.

She is beautiful, but there is something predatory in the stillness of her face. When she notices you watching, the corner of her mouth lifts into the faintest smile, revealing the tip of a single white fang.

Heavy iron shackles hang from her wrists, but the chains that once held them to the wall lie broken across the stone floor.

She doesn't approach.

She simply watches you.
battle_cries: The vampire hisses, “Your warmth will be mine!”
The vampire bares its fangs and lunges.
Stares hungrily at the vein in your neck and jumps reaching toward your face.
defeat_messages: The vampire looks at you wide eyed and then crumples to the floor.  It lets out a low hiss as its body turns to dust.
vampire.captive_description: The vampire grips the iron bars, pale eyes following your every movement.
captive_actions: “Open this cage, mortal,” the vampire whispers.
The vampire recoils from a shaft of light.
"You cannot keep me in here forever," she whispers.

conversations.response: The vampire smiles. “A polite visitor. How unusual.”
The vampire bares her fangs. “How about now.”

prairie_wolf.name: Prairie wolf
prairie_wolf.description: A lean grey wolf moves low through the grass, watching for weakness.
defeat_messages: Prairie wolf sinks into the grass and lies still.
prairie_wolf.captive_description: Prairie wolf shifts restlessly behind the bars.
captive_actions: Prairie wolf tests the iron bars, then settles back.

horned_hare.name: Horned hare
horned_hare.description: A jackrabbit with small curved horns freezes beside a clump of seed grass.
defeat_messages: Horned hare sinks into the grass and lies still.
horned_hare.captive_description: Horned hare shifts restlessly behind the bars.
captive_actions: Horned hare tests the iron bars, then settles back.

grassland_boar.name: Grassland boar
grassland_boar.description: A scarred boar roots beneath the turf, its tusks bright with scraped earth.
defeat_messages: Grassland boar sinks into the grass and lies still.
grassland_boar.captive_description: Grassland boar shifts restlessly behind the bars.
captive_actions: Grassland boar tests the iron bars, then settles back.

prairie_raider.name: Prairie raider
prairie_raider.description: A weather-beaten raider waits beside the trail, one hand on a chipped blade.
defeat_messages: Prairie raider sinks into the grass and lies still.
prairie_raider.captive_description: Prairie raider shifts restlessly behind the bars.
captive_actions: Prairie raider tests the iron bars, then settles back.

ridge_lion.name: Ridge lion
ridge_lion.description: A tawny mountain lion lies among the rocks, its tail flicking against the stone.
defeat_messages: Ridge lion sinks into the grass and lies still.
ridge_lion.captive_description: Ridge lion shifts restlessly behind the bars.
captive_actions: Ridge lion tests the iron bars, then settles back.

cave_troll.name: Cave troll
cave_troll.description: A huge cave troll has wandered down from the mountain caves. Dusty stone plates cover its shoulders; each breath rolls like thunder.
battle_cries: The cave troll bellows, “BACK TO THE LOWLANDS!”
The troll slams its fists into the earth and roars.
defeat_messages: The cave troll buckles, shaking the ground as it falls.
cave_troll.captive_description: The troll crouches in its cage, glaring out beneath a ridged brow.
captive_actions: The troll drums thick fingers against the bars.
A rumbling complaint rises from the cage.

deer.name: Coppergrass deer
deer.description: A coppergrass deer watches the open grassland.

turkey.name: Prairie turkey
turkey.description: A prairie turkey watches the open grassland.

square.name: Center Square
square.description: Rain-dark flagstones surround a fountain threaded with blue light. Beyond the roofs, the frontier waits. A brass sign points travelers toward the northern gate.  A crumbled stone sits half buried in the ground.

objects.fountain: Water circles a humming crystal. No one remembers who built it.  It seems to hum magically.
objects.sign:
EAST: Anthony's General Supply.
WEST: Local Inn.
NORTH: Out of Town
South: Jake's Acquisitions
objects.crumbled stone: It looks ancient.  If you look carefully there is a small inscription carved into the stone.  It reads: "Nic and Anthony were here"

shop.name: Anthony's General Store
shop.description: Dried herbs hang above jars of luminous powder. Anthony taps the counter: 'A potion before trouble is cheaper than a funeral.' Type BUY to see his stock.

objects.mara: Anthony buys spare equipment and ancient scrap. BUY or SELL an item by name.
objects.counter: Potions, a crystal lantern, and dependable ironwork.

inn.name: The Quiet Coil
inn.description: A wood fire competes with the soft glow of a salvaged heater. Clean beds line the far wall. Type REST to recover fully at no cost.

objects.heater: The machine warms the room without smoke. Someone has painted flowers on it.

gate.name: North Gate
gate.description: Timber walls end at an arch of older metal. The road continues north between wind-bent grasses.

objects.arch: Tiny lettering runs beneath the rust: TRANSIT / SECTOR 04.

road.name: Frontier Road
road.description: Cart ruts fade into the open meadow. Farther north, a black opening cuts into the hillside.

objects.ruts: Fresh bootprints overlap the tracks of something with jointed metal feet.

meadow.name: Coppergrass Meadow
meadow.description: Copper-tipped grass brushes your knees. A cave mouth lies to the east, its edges too perfectly round to be natural.

objects.grass: The stems collect flecks of rust-colored mineral dust.

mouth.name: Relic Cave Entrance
mouth.description: Daylight reaches a ring of smooth stone. Steps descend north into darkness. Scratches score the walls at goblin height.

objects.scratches: Warning marks. Something here does not welcome visitors.
objects.steps: Stone gives way to riveted metal beneath the dust.

tunnel.name: Dark Conduit
tunnel.description: Your light finds bundled cables in the walls. Water drips from a broken pipe, counting the seconds. The passage runs north toward a pale mechanical glow.

objects.cables: Copper veins disappear into a sealed service hatch.
objects.hatch: The hatch is fused shut. Its engraving reads: KEEP THE SENTINEL ASLEEP.

vault.name: The Sleeping Engine
vault.description: A vast ring of silent equipment surrounds a fractured pedestal. Blue pulses crawl across the floor. This place was a laboratory long before it became a legend.

objects.pedestal: An empty cradle holds the outline of a slender blade.
objects.equipment: Most panels are dead. One repeats a single word: CONTAINMENT.

dungeon.name: Hidden Dungeon
dungeon.description:
Behind the false stone wall, a narrow passage descends into a chamber untouched for years. The air is unnaturally cold, carrying the smell of damp stone and ancient dust. Faded symbols have been carved around the doorway, as though meant to keep something inside.

A cracked stone coffin rests against one wall, surrounded by rusted chains, extinguished candles, and scattered bones.

discoveries.name: Old rusty key
discoveries.message: With the vampire defeated, you spot an old rusty key among the stones behind its resting place.

discoveries.name: Old crypt box
discoveries.description: A narrow ironbound box stood concealed behind the vampire. A rusted lock seals its lid.
discoveries.message: Behind the fallen vampire, an you spot an old crypt box.
discoveries.open_message: The old lock snaps open. A gust of nasty, thick rancid air gushes out of the chest.  Dawnfang rests inside on brittle, cracked leather.

prairie_0_0.name: Sundown Flats
prairie_0_0.description: Long bands of copper and silver grass roll west beneath an enormous sky. Wind carries the smell of dry earth; far north, blue mountains stand above the prairie.

objects.wind-carved stones: Smooth stones rise from the turf like the backs of sleeping animals.

prairie_1_0.name: Larkspur Sea
prairie_1_0.description: Violet larkspur nods among waist-high grasses. Skylarks wheel overhead, and faint game trails spread in every direction beneath the open sky.

objects.larkspur: Bees disappear into the violet blooms. Beyond them, the grass ripples for miles.

prairie_2_0.name: Old Wagon Trace
prairie_2_0.description: Two shallow wheel ruts cross the open prairie and fade beneath new grass. To the north the land rises gently toward distant grey foothills.

objects.broken wheel: Half a wagon wheel rests in the turf, bleached by many summers.

prairie_3_0.name: Coppergrass Reach
prairie_3_0.description: Coppergrass Meadow opens westward into a broad sweep of prairie. Amber stems brush your legs and the mountains stretch across the northern horizon.

objects.trail marker: A low stack of stones marks the way east to Coppergrass Meadow.

prairie_0_1.name: Buffalo Hollow
prairie_0_1.description: A wide shallow hollow shelters thick, sweet grass. Old hoofprints quilt its edges, and a dry breeze hums over the surrounding rises.

objects.hoofprints: Heavy tracks cross lighter deer prints in the baked mud.

prairie_1_1.name: Whistling Grass
prairie_1_1.description: Tall seed heads hiss and whistle in the wind. The prairie stretches unbroken east and west, while northern slopes show darker seams of exposed rock.

objects.seed heads: Their copper tips scatter fine seeds into the moving air.

prairie_2_1.name: Sunken Creek
prairie_2_1.description: A narrow stream threads a grassy depression, its clear water bright over flat stones. On either side, low banks give way to the open prairie.

objects.stream: Tiny fish hold their place in the current beneath a shelf of stone.

prairie_3_1.name: Hawk’s Rise
prairie_3_1.description: A gentle swell lifts you above the grass. Hawks circle on rising air, and you can see the route back to the meadow far to the southeast.

objects.hawk perch: A dead tree offers the only high perch for a long way around.

prairie_0_2.name: Redstone Shelf
prairie_0_2.description: Rust-red slabs break through the grass as the ground begins to climb. The prairie remains wide and open behind you, but mountain shadows reach this far at dusk.

objects.redstone: Thin red layers crumble at the edges; older grey stone lies beneath.

prairie_1_2.name: Split Boulder Plain
prairie_1_2.description: A split boulder stands alone in a field of pale grass. Small animal trails run between scattered stones toward the rising foothills.

objects.split boulder: A narrow cleft divides the boulder. Wind whistles through it like a distant flute.

prairie_2_2.name: Last Camp
prairie_2_2.description: A cold circle of camp stones sits on a breezy rise. Beyond it, the mountains fill the northern sky; behind you, the prairie rolls toward copper-colored lowlands.

objects.camp stones: Ash has washed into the soil. A snapped tent peg remains between two stones.

prairie_3_2.name: Lionwatch Knoll
prairie_3_2.description: Dry grass clings to a broad knoll dotted with grey rock. There is little cover here, and the slopes ahead are scarred by gullies running down from the mountains.

objects.scratched rock: Deep claw marks score the stone beside a patch of flattened grass.

prairie_0_3.name: Western Scree Edge
prairie_0_3.description: Open grass thins against a fan of mountain scree. High to the north, dark cave mouths puncture the cliffs. There is no safe mountain route here yet.

objects.cave mouths: The openings are distant and deep in shadow. Something large has disturbed the scree below them.

prairie_1_3.name: Thunderstone Foothill
prairie_1_3.description: A low rolling foothill meets the first steep mountain face. Broken boulders lie scattered over short grass, and deep echoes sometimes drift down from hidden caves.

objects.boulders: Several stones bear fresh scrapes much higher than your head.

prairie_2_3.name: Coldwater Fan
prairie_2_3.description: A cold mountain trickle spreads over gravel before vanishing into the prairie soil. The northern cliffs loom above, their cave mouths black against pale stone.

objects.gravel: Large uneven footprints cross the gravel and disappear among the rocks.

prairie_3_3.name: Eastern Mountain Verge
prairie_3_3.description: The prairie reaches the foot of a long grey escarpment. Wind pours from northern ravines and sweeps the low grass flat. The mountains remain beyond reach for now.

objects.ravines: The narrow clefts are too steep to climb here. Loose stones sometimes tumble from above.

south_street.name: South Market Street
south_street.description: Warm brick walls border a short street south of Center Square. A painted beetle hangs above the eastern doorway, where an occasional chirp or low growl escapes from Jake’s Critters.

objects.painted beetle: The sign reads: Jake’s Critters. Fair coin for unusual company. Cages included.
objects.bank sign: WEST: The Brass Badger Bank. Your gold, your account, no exceptions. Ask for Osric Tallywick.

brass_badger_bank.name: The Brass Badger Bank
brass_badger_bank.description: A brass badger above the door insists, in tiny letters, that it is not a piggy bank. Inside, crooked towers of ledgers surround a polished counter and a humming relic vault. The banker sorts coins into teacups while arguing with a clock that has thirteen hands. BALANCE checks your account; DEPOSIT and WITHDRAW accept an amount or ALL.

objects.vault: Blue threads of light recognize each depositor. The vault releases gold only to the character who owns the account.
objects.clock: Thirteen hands disagree with one another. A label reads: INTERESTING, BUT NOT INTEREST-BEARING.
objects.teacups: Each teacup holds a different coin denomination. None contains tea.

jakes_critters.name: Jake's Critters
jakes_critters.description: Clean straw, polished cage bars, and shelves of feed fill Jake’s little shop. Jake looks up from his ledger. “Bring me a creature in a cage and I’ll make you an offer. Every occupant counts—and the cage stays with me.”

objects.ledger: Jake prices each creature separately and multiplies by the number in its cage. Type SELL to see offers for the occupied cages you carry.

hidden_dungeon_bedroom.name: Hidden dungeon Bedroom
hidden_dungeon_bedroom.description: A small room covered in inches of dust that looks almost completely undisturbed.  It is a small room that looks like it once belonged to an ancient day prepper.  There is a cot still made up neatly along one wall and the other is lined with random tools, preserved food, and wooden barrels that once presumably held water.

scorched.name: Scorched
scorched.description: Lingering heat deals 2 damage each combat pulse.

poisoned.name: Poisoned
poisoned.description: A mild poison; refreshes rather than stacking.

stunned.name: Stunned
stunned.description: Cannot attack or use skills for two pulses.

osric_tallywick.name: Osric Tallywick
osric_tallywick.appearance: A narrow man in a violet waistcoat wears three pairs of spectacles and keeps a brass spoon tucked behind each ear.
osric_tallywick.description: Osric addresses every coin as 'Professor' and insists the vault is shy. He counts flawlessly while wearing his ledger upside down on a stand.

dialogue.response: Welcome, welcome! Wipe your boots and introduce your gold. The vault dislikes strangers, but remembers its depositors perfectly.
BALANCE, DEPOSIT 20, WITHDRAW 20! ALL works too. Your account follows your identity, not your name or your face. Especially not your face.
Death is a dreadful accountant. Your purse stays with your body, but gold deposited here remains yours. Come back in whatever state you find yourself.
Thirteen hands, and not one has stolen a penny. An exemplary employee.

osric_tallywick.default_response: Ask me about the bank, death, or that suspiciously punctual clock.

tamsin.name: Tamsin
tamsin.appearance: A traveler warms her hands around a tin cup.
tamsin.description: Her pack smells faintly of woodsmoke and dried herbs.

dialogue.response: Hello, traveler. The inn keeps a cooking fire ready.
HARVEST defeated deer, turkeys or beetles, then COOK their recipe at a fire.

tamsin.default_response: I know a little about cooking. Ask me about cooking.

lilla.name: Lilla
lilla.appearance: Lilla is a beautiful little fairy, barely three inches tall, with bright eyes and delicate wings that shimmer with iridescent light.
lilla.description:
Lilla darts here and there, trailing tiny sparks of magic, her musical laughter making ordinary moments feel enchanted.

An adult fairy with boundless youthful spunk, she finds delight in the smallest things. Depending on her mood, she can be a perfect little angel—tenderhearted and eager to help—or a mischievous pest, delivering teasing remarks and insults before darting just beyond reach.

For all her tiny stature, Lilla has a wonderfully bold spirit. She sees a world full of friends to meet, secrets to discover, and rules that might be more fun with a few exceptions.
